provenance.post_title: Your Character, Your Dice, Your Way
provenance.asset_description: Grid of different dice options, listed left to right in five rows of five. Row one: Green Barbarian D20, Blue Sword D12, Red Druid D20, Green Flail D8, Blue Bard D20. Row two: Red Chaotic D6, Blue wizard D20, Green Witch - Hero D20, Grey Brawling D6, Red Bleed D6. Row three, Grey fighter D20, Green Spear D8, Red Dart D6, Blue sling D6, Blue staff D4. Row four: Green magic missile D4, Blue Oracle - hero D20, Green mental D6, Grey rogue - hero D20, Green Acid D12. Row five: blue Healing D4, Red burning hands D6, grey damage D8, blue Cold D12, red ranger D20
